北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴凉有风，体感 13℃，记得添衣保暖，注意补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cool and windy, feels like 13℃. Dress warmly and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光正好，气温 22℃，体感舒适。外出记得防晒，享受好天气！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant, 22℃. Enjoy the lovely weather, don't forget sun protection!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，气温 19℃，体感宜人。湿度略高，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, 19℃. A pleasant day, but a bit humid. Stay cheerful!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 天气温暖，体感 30℃ 左右，小心暑热。多喝水，防晒要做好哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Warm, feels like 30℃. Watch out for the heat! Stay hydrated and use sunscreen.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴沉，体感 27℃，湿度较高。出门别忘带伞，注意防潮！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and warm, feels like 27℃, with high humidity. Carry an umbrella and stay dry!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光明媚，气温 22℃，体感舒适。很适合户外活动，心情愉快！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and 22℃, feels comfortable. Perfect for outdoor activities, enjoy your day!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 天气晴朗，气温 22℃，体感舒适。空气略干，多喝水润润喉！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Clear skies, 22℃, feels pleasant. Air is a bit dry, remember to hydrate!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨天气，气温 25℃。出门记得带好雨具，小心路滑，注意安全。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Light rain, 25℃. Carry an umbrella, watch for slippery roads, and stay safe.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天，气温 23℃，体感 26℃，湿度很高。注意防潮，保持清爽。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, 23℃ but feels like 26℃, very humid. Watch for dampness and stay cool.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴沉，体感 15℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣，小心着凉哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, feels like 15℃. Big temperature difference, dress in layers to avoid colds!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天，气温 27℃，体感略热。多补充水分，出门记得带伞防晒。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, 27℃, feels warm. Stay hydrated and carry an umbrella for sun protection.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨绵绵，气温 8℃，体感寒冷。多穿衣物，出门带伞，小心湿滑！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Light rain, 8℃, feels chilly. Dress warmly, carry an umbrella, and be careful of wet surfaces!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天有风，体感 11℃。风力 4级 较大，请务必多穿，注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and windy, feels like 11℃ with 4级 wind. Dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降9℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，体感 16℃ 左右。昼夜温差大，早晚添衣，注意身体。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, feels like 16℃. Big day-night temperature difference, dress in layers!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 多云，气温 21℃，湿度 83% 较高。风力 3级，出门防风，保持好心情！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, 21℃ with 83% humidity. Moderate wind. Protect from wind, stay cheerful!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天有风，体感 10℃，湿度 85% 较高。注意添衣保暖，防湿防凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and windy, feels like 10℃ with high humidity. Dress warmly and protect from dampness and cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天，体感 14℃ 左右。外出记得添衣，小心昼夜温差，保重身体。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, feels around 14℃. Dress in layers, watch out for temperature changes, and stay well.
